title: RFC 4648 base32 encode/decode for TOTP secrets
spec: Implement base32::encode (standard alphabet A-Z2-7, '=' padding to a multiple of 8) and base32::decode (case-insensitive, padding optional, spaces and hyphens ignored; any other character, data after padding, or an unpadded length of 1, 3 or 6 mod 8 is Error::BadBase32). No new dependencies.
